credit_ledger_entry_effective_rate.name: credit_ledger_entry_effective_rate
credit_ledger_entry_effective_rate.value: "credit_ledger_entry"."effective_usd_to_sar_rate_e6" is null or ("credit_ledger_entry"."usd_to_sar_rate_e6" is not null and "credit_ledger_entry"."fx_spread_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "credit_ledger_entry"."effective_usd_to_sar_rate_e6"::bigint = ("credit_ledger_entry"."usd_to_sar_rate_e6"::bigint * (10000 + "credit_ledger_entry"."fx_spread_bps") + 9999) / 10000)

credit_ledger_entry_usage_has_cost_and_r.name: credit_ledger_entry_usage_has_cost_and_rate
credit_ledger_entry_usage_has_cost_and_r.value: "credit_ledger_entry"."kind" <> 'usage' or ("credit_ledger_entry"."cost_micro_usd" is not null and "credit_ledger_entry"."usd_to_sar_rate_e6" is not null and "credit_ledger_entry"."fx_spread_bps" is not null and "credit_ledger_entry"."effective_usd_to_sar_rate_e6" is not null)

credit_ledger_entry_promo_code.name: credit_ledger_entry_promo_code
credit_ledger_entry_promo_code.value: ("credit_ledger_entry"."kind" <> 'promo' or "credit_ledger_entry"."promo_code_id" is not null) and ("credit_ledger_entry"."promo_code_id" is null or "credit_ledger_entry"."kind" in ('promo', 'top_up'))

credit_ledger_entry_topup_fee.name: credit_ledger_entry_topup_fee
credit_ledger_entry_topup_fee.value: ("credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_bps" is null and "credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_min_micro_sar" is null and "credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_source" is null) or ("credit_ledger_entry"."kind" = 'top_up' and "credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_bps" >= 0 and "credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_min_micro_sar" >= 0 and "credit_ledger_entry"."topup_fee_source" in ('default', 'organization', 'promo'))

credit_reservation_open_virtualKeyId_idx.name: credit_reservation_open_virtualKeyId_idx
credit_reservation_open_virtualKeyId_idx.where: "credit_reservation"."settled_at" is null and "credit_reservation"."virtual_key_id" is not null

organization_topup_fee_sets_something.name: organization_topup_fee_sets_something
organization_topup_fee_sets_something.value: "organization_topup_fee"."fee_bps" is not null or "organization_topup_fee"."fee_min_micro_sar" is not null

pricing_settings_topup_presets_range.name: pricing_settings_topup_presets_range
pricing_settings_topup_presets_range.value: cardinality("pricing_settings"."topup_presets_micro_sar") between 1 and 8 and array_position("pricing_settings"."topup_presets_micro_sar", null) is null and "pricing_settings"."topup_min_micro_sar" <= all("pricing_settings"."topup_presets_micro_sar") and "pricing_settings"."topup_max_micro_sar" >= all("pricing_settings"."topup_presets_micro_sar")

api_key_limit_reset_needs_limit.name: api_key_limit_reset_needs_limit
api_key_limit_reset_needs_limit.value: "api_key"."limit_reset" is null or "api_key"."limit_micro_sar" is not null

provider_endpoint_change_removal_has_no_.name: provider_endpoint_change_removal_has_no_terms
provider_endpoint_change_removal_has_no_.value:
case when "provider_endpoint_change"."is_removed"
        then "provider_endpoint_change"."region" is null and "provider_endpoint_change"."retention_days" is null and "provider_endpoint_change"."trains_on_data" is null
          and "provider_endpoint_change"."agreement" is null and "provider_endpoint_change"."source" is null and "provider_endpoint_change"."verified_on" is null
        else "provider_endpoint_change"."region" is not null and "provider_endpoint_change"."agreement" is not null
          and "provider_endpoint_change"."source" is not null and "provider_endpoint_change"."verified_on" is not null
      end

promo_code_amounts_match_kind.name: promo_code_amounts_match_kind
promo_code_amounts_match_kind.value:
("promo_code"."kind" = 'fee_discount' and (("promo_code"."fee_discount_bps" is null) <> ("promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" is null)) and "promo_code"."bonus_bps" is null and "promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" is null and "promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" is null)
        or ("promo_code"."kind" = 'topup_bonus' and "promo_code"."bonus_bps" is not null and "promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" is not null and "promo_code"."fee_discount_bps" is null and "promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" is null and "promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" is null)
        or ("promo_code"."kind" = 'free_credit' and "promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" is not null and "promo_code"."fee_discount_bps" is null and "promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" is null and "promo_code"."bonus_bps" is null and "promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" is null and "promo_code"."min_topup_micro_sar" is null)

promo_code_bps_range.name: promo_code_bps_range
promo_code_bps_range.value: ("promo_code"."fee_discount_bps" is null or "promo_code"."fee_discount_bps" between 1 and 10000) and ("promo_code"."bonus_bps" is null or "promo_code"."bonus_bps" between 1 and 10000)

promo_code_amounts_halalas.name: promo_code_amounts_halalas
promo_code_amounts_halalas.value: ("promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" is null or ("promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" > 0 and "promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" <= 10000000000 and "promo_code"."fee_discount_micro_sar" % 10000 = 0)) and ("promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" is null or ("promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" > 0 and "promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" <= 10000000000 and "promo_code"."bonus_cap_micro_sar" % 10000 = 0)) and ("promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" is null or ("promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" > 0 and "promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" <= 10000000000 and "promo_code"."credit_micro_sar" % 10000 = 0)) and ("promo_code"."min_topup_micro_sar" is null or ("promo_code"."min_topup_micro_sar" > 0 and "promo_code"."min_topup_micro_sar" <= 10000000000 and "promo_code"."min_topup_micro_sar" % 10000 = 0))

promo_code_dates.name: promo_code_dates
promo_code_dates.value: "promo_code"."starts_at" is null or "promo_code"."ends_at" is null or "promo_code"."ends_at" > "promo_code"."starts_at"
